svg.title: NPN bipolar transistor
svg.desc: NPN bipolar transistor, IEEE 315-1975 §8.6.2 NPN transistor, with envelope (Introduction A4.11; emitter and collector per §8.2.4–8.2.5). Drawn at Q1's place in the Schematex circuit exemplar (exemplar viewBox 1102 428 96 80) with the same pins, revised as the manifest notes say; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: collector (88,8), base (8,40), emitter (88,72).
